text.en:
Mayor, City of Manila
An Undersecretary of the Department of Public
Works and Highways, to be designated
by the Secretary, DPWH
-
Executive Director, Philippine Convention and
Visitors Corporation
-
The Committee shall meet as frequendy as necessary in order to review,
revise, adopt and or approve policies and guidelines recommended by the
Executive Director.
The Executive Director of the NPDC shall have the following
powers and duties:
To execute and administer the policies and measures adopted by
the Committee;
act as Chief Executive Officer and directly manage and
supervise the day to day operations and internal administration of
the NPDC, and sign all agreements and contracts entered into for
and in its behalf;
To prepare the agenda for the meetings of, and to submit for the
consideration of the members of the Committee all policies and
measures which he believes to be necessary to carry out its
prepare and submit an annual budget and necessary
supplemental budgets for the consideration of the members of
the Committee;
)
To appoint, discipline and remove, and define the duties of the
NPDC's personnel subject to existing Civil Service Rules and
Regulations; and
To exercise and perform such other powers and duties as may be
vested in him or assigned by the Committee.
The NPDC may coordinate with and seek the assistance of other
agencies of
the government,
authorized
donations/ grants from the private sector, subject to the usual government
accounting and auditing rules and regulations.
All other laws, rules and regulations and executive issuances
inconsistent with this Executive Order are hereby deemed repealed or modified
accordingly.
This Executive Order shall take effect immediately.
